item.title: OpenAI Hires Ex-Uber President Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
item.description:
OpenAI said on Nov 3 that Jill Hazelbaker, formerly president and chief corporate affairs officer at Uber, will join as its own chief corporate affairs officer, leading global communications and corporate positioning. She previously ran communications and public policy at Snap and held senior roles at Google, after starting her career in US politics as national communications director for John McCain's 2008 presidential campaign. President Greg Brockman framed the hire around winning public trust as AI reaches more people, describing her as the leader OpenAI needs for its next phase.

原文标题：OpenAI 任命原 Uber 总裁 Jill Hazelbaker 为首席企业事务官

item.title: Global Silicon Wafer Shipments Rise 13.4% Year-on-Year in Q3 2026, SEMI Says
item.description:
Global silicon wafer shipments reached 3.756 billion square inches in Q3 2026 — roughly 33.21 million 300mm-equivalent wafers — up 13.4% year-on-year and 5.1% quarter-on-quarter, according to SEMI's Silicon Manufacturers Group. SEMI attributes the growth to AI demand spreading from advanced logic and memory into power devices and photonics, alongside recovering demand from robotics, AI server power supplies and general industrial semiconductors. The figures indicate that AI compute buildout is feeding through to wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging.

原文标题：SEMI：2026Q3 全球硅晶圆出货量同比增长 13.4%

Why it matters：这是观察 AI 算力需求如何传导至半导体上游的关键季度指标，数据来自官方统计，且具有可验证性。

item.title: 美国 AI 扩张遭遇地方阻力：水电资源和环境争议升温，76% 选民反对在社区建设数据中心
item.description:
北京时间 11 月 5 日，据美国科技媒体 The Verge 报道，随着 2026 年美国中期选举结果陆续出炉，人工智能行业赖以发展的数据中心建设遭遇重大阻力。 美国多地选民通过地方公投限制数据中心扩张，多名支持暂停相关项目建设的候选人赢得选举，意味着美国 AI 数据中心开发商未来可能面临更加严格的监管环境。 美国全国广播公司（NBC News）在选举日开展的民调显示，76% 的受访选民反对在自己居住的社区建设数据中心。与此同时，针对数据中心建设的地方公投也呈现明显的限制开发倾向。 根据咨询机构 Redbud Consulting 汇总的数据，截至当地时间 11 月 4 日上午，在全美涉及数据中心开发的 45 项地方投票议案中，已有 33 项结果支持限制数据中心建设。 部分地方政府采取了相当严格的措施。例如，缅因州韦尔斯镇选民支持暂停大型数据中心建设 180 天；俄亥俄州多个城市投票禁止建设用电规模超过 25 兆瓦的数据中心；堪萨斯州埃尔多拉多市则投票决定，在未来 10 年内禁止建设峰值用电负荷超过 10 兆瓦的数据中心。 这股反对数据中心无序扩张的浪潮，也影响了多个州的政治格局。 ...

item.title: Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs in Talks to Raise $5B at $50B Valuation
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Isomorphic Labs, the Alphabet unit spun out of Google DeepMind, is negotiating a roughly $5B raise at about a $50B valuation, despite having no drug yet tested in humans. Its core asset is a drug-design engine built on AlphaFold 3 that predicts protein folding and how candidate molecules bind their targets, letting chemists rank and discard weak designs on a computer before paying for synthesis and animal studies. Without human data, the $50B price rests on prediction accuracy and pharma partnerships rather than evidence that its molecules work in patients.

原文标题：Isomorphic Labs 洽谈 50 亿美元融资 估值约 500 亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 制药领域估值最高的一笔融资动向之一，也直接暴露了“预测能力”与“临床验证”之间的估值鸿沟。

item.title: Goldman Sachs Flags Political Risk to 45% of Planned US Data Center Buildout
item.description:

In parallel, Anthropic's amended IPO filing disclosed about $895.4B in compute and infrastructure commitments for the first time, including roughly $451B in signed leases that have not commenced, so a construction freeze would block already-contracted capacity rather than merely protect it. Combined with Goldman and Visible Alpha estimates, hyperscaler capex is projected to rise from about $0.46T in 2025 to about $1.75T by 2030.

原文标题：高盛改口：数据中心所在州政治风险或影响 45% 美国扩建计划

item.title: USTC Releases Open-Source RNA Foundation Model structRFM, Published in Nature
item.description:
The MIRACLE lab at USTC has released structRFM, an open-source RNA sequence foundation model whose accompanying paper appeared in Nature on November 5. Pretrained with structure-guided objectives over roughly 21 million computationally annotated sequence–secondary-structure pairs, the model takes only sequence input and emits sequence-, nucleotide-, and nucleotide-pair-level features, reaching state-of-the-art results on secondary and tertiary structure prediction plus downstream tasks such as splice-site prediction, IRES recognition, and non-coding RNA classification. Full paired data, model weights, and source code have been open-sourced, making it a directly reusable artifact for AI-for-science readers.

原文标题：中国科大开源 RNA 基础模型 structRFM，成果登上 Nature

Why it matters：这是一次完整的开源交付，包含数据、权重与代码，且方法有新意；它把结构引导预训练带入 RNA 领域，并由《自然》论文与消融实验背书。

item.title: Arm Q2 营收创纪录 AGI CPU 获订单
item.description:
Arm 公布 2027 财年第二财季业绩，营收达 14.43 亿美元创历史新高，同比增长 27%。尽管 GAAP 净利润因一次性因素同比下滑 45%，但非 GAAP 利润稳健增长。关键亮点在于其专为 AI 设计的 AGI CPU 已获得多家客户订单，预计 2027 财年第四季度启动首批商业交付，同时数据中心版税收入翻倍。

Why it matters：Arm 作为 AI 算力基础设施核心供应商，其专用 AI 芯片（AGI CPU）获得实质订单并明确交付时间表，标志着其在高端 AI 计算领域的商业化突破，对行业格局有重要影响。
